title: Aureline M5 linked-change panel
description: Canonical per-domain descriptor for a linked-change panel. Names the object class, its change-intent association, the linked target identity, and the relation source (linked by provider, linked locally, suggested by Aureline, stale or broken relation) — so the four relation kinds are never flattened into one generic badge. Downstream the linked-change panel, work-item detail, review detail, and support / export packets point at this schema instead of restating a relation by hand. Raw paths, secret values, and private endpoints never cross this boundary.
